rv.q: I am loath to overpraise this little gem. I know sophisticates will find it thin, predictable, and often unconvincing in its details.
It is an act of prestidigitation: Entertainment and real emotional engagement are pulled out of thin air.
Like a Hallmark movie, “Two Strangers” boasts enough humor and whimsy to be sweet and superficially appealing, but at the end, all we’re left with is the superficial.

cn.t: This modest British rom-com musical charms with its intimate two-hander format and solid book, even if the score doesn't quite match the appeal of its winning performances and surprising heart.
